findings: The AI/ML subset distinction is supported, but AI also includes manually defined rule-based systems, which need not learn from training data.
The claim that algorithms evolve/adapt as they process more data and thereby improve accuracy is too broad: a deployed model may remain fixed, and updates require evaluation.
NLP and computer vision are application areas that can themselves use ML; they are not clean examples separating AI from ML.
accuracy_review.proposed_correction: Machine learning is one approach within AI. Models learn patterns during training; deployed models do not necessarily keep learning, and more data does not guarantee better performance. Other AI approaches can use explicitly defined rules.

backend_contract_if_later_approved.activation: Do not set PUBLIC_CONTACT_FORM_ENDPOINT until server/data-handling acceptance signed off.
backend_contract_if_later_approved.request: Same-origin POST multipart FormData, fields type/form_kind/name/email/company/phone/message/interests; current client limits name120/email254/company160/phone40/message3000. Server independently bounds total body and repeated/unknown fields.
backend_contract_if_later_approved.validation: Server validates schema, email/header controls, allowed interests, origin/CSRF policy, fixed recipient/sender, rate/bot limits and idempotency; no file uploads or visitor URL fetches.
backend_contract_if_later_approved.success: 2xx application/json {ok:true} only after defined durable acceptance/delivery. Client rejects HTML 200, {ok:false}, malformed JSON, non-2xx and redirects. Define what acceptance guarantees before claiming receipt.
backend_contract_if_later_approved.failure: Truthful accessible failure, enabled retry, direct email/phone fallback; abort/15s client timeout.
backend_contract_if_later_approved.privacy: No-store API responses, no wildcard CORS, minimized/redacted logs, confirmed processor/retention and approved effective notice before collection.
